description: Used to track user login and authentication events.

fields.description: The name of the user being authenticated.
The IPv4 or IPv6 address of the client initiating the authentication.
The outcome of the authentication event, such as success or failure.
The application involved in the authentication event.

description: Used to track network communication between devices.

fields.description: The source IP address of the network connection.
The destination IP address of the network connection.
The destination port of the network connection.
Number of bytes received by the destination.
